concerns.text: FR‑001 requires a linked BFI‑2 + Last.fm dataset, but the plan states the Last.fm data is unavailable and flags FR‑001 as partially unmet, leaving the core functional requirement unfulfilled.
FR‑003 specifies Pearson correlation, yet the plan computes Spearman correlation, violating the functional requirement.
The plan performs a priori power analysis (SC‑003) which is not defined in the specification; this introduces a requirement that the spec does not contain.
SC‑008 is referenced for contract validation, but no SC‑008 exists in the spec, resulting in an over‑reach of the plan beyond the documented success criteria.
SC‑003 is mentioned in the plan (power analysis) but is absent from the spec, constituting an unnecessary extra success criterion.
